skill.ba_martialarts.boxer.tooltip: Boxing: jab, cross, hook, power straight; the 4th hit causes a long stun. Combat Art: Crushing Uppercut.
skill.ba_martialarts.karateka.tooltip: Karate: straight punches and mae-geri, the heaviest unarmed hit. Combat Art: Kiai.
skill.ba_martialarts.nak_muay.tooltip: Muay Thai: punches, a double kick and a roundhouse finisher. Combat Art: Flying Knee.
skill.ba_martialarts.kung_fu_master.tool: Kung Fu: fast palms, crane kick and twin palms. Combat Art: Chi Palm.
skill.ba_martialarts.taekwondoin.tooltip: Taekwondo: a combo made only of kicks, axe kick in the air. Combat Art: Tornado Kick.
skill.ba_martialarts.judoka.tooltip: Judo: pushes and grips, counter throw after a dodge. Combat Art: Ippon.
skill.ba_martialarts.crushing_uppercut.t: Rising uppercut: lifts the enemy and knocks them down.
skill.ba_martialarts.kiai.tooltip: Strike with a battle cry: a 5-block wave neutralizes up to 6 enemies.
skill.ba_martialarts.flying_knee.tooltip: Leaping knee strike that knocks the enemy down.
skill.ba_martialarts.chi_palm.tooltip: Twin palms: a 5-block Chi wave pierces armor and launches up to 5 enemies.
skill.ba_martialarts.tornado_kick.toolti: Flip jump: three kicks hit everyone around, the last one knocks down.
skill.ba_martialarts.ippon.tooltip: Grip and throw: the enemy lands behind you on the ground.
skill.ba_martialarts.flurry_of_blows.too: 8 punches keep the enemy stunned, the last one knocks them down. Works with any unarmed style.
skill.ba_martialarts.ultra_instinct.tool: The body fights on its own: 15 s of step dodges with afterimages and style counters, +40% damage, +25% speed, faster combos, free Combat Arts. Triggers by itself near defeat (once per 5 minutes). Afterwards your stamina is empty.
msg.ba_martialarts.ui.title: ULTRA INSTINCT
msg.ba_martialarts.ui.auto: Your body keeps fighting while unconscious...
msg.ba_martialarts.ui.manual: The mind goes silent. The body knows what to do.
msg.ba_martialarts.ui.end: Your body is at its limit...
